premises: Equiatomic FeCoNiMnCu thin films are magnetically soft with coercivity ~10 Oe
RTA of FeCoNiMnCu films yields a single FCC phase and ~40-fold coercivity increase
Adding 50 at.% Pt to FeCoNiMnCu and applying RTA forms an L1₀ high entropy intermetallic phase
The L1₀ phase exhibits high magnetic anisotropy and 3 orders of magnitude coercivity increase
